title: Gargoyle
altText: Stunning vertical street art mural by Mr Blob in France, featuring a majestic surreal phoenix character with glowing magma cracks, metallic wings, and vibrant neon light-emission effects on a black facade.
description: Painted on a tall black gable in Saint-Brieuc for the Just Do Paint festival, Gargoyle depicts a monumental perched creature with a golden, armor-like beaked head and cascading metallic plumage, its stone body cracking into glowing magma veins and floating shards. The vertical format and dark background amplify the neon light-emission effects, giving the guardian figure the presence of a living sculpture set into the architecture.
